Bento cards.

Web·by @emblemo·2026-09-03·inspora page·original post

What it is

Static bento grid of 4 portfolio cards orbited by a single thick white stroke that continuously draws itself along a rounded scribble path looping around the cards.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-15%
Grid settled: tall orange 'Product UI & web' card left, pink 'Icons' top-right, yellow 'Illustrations' below, wide purple 'AI Design Setup' bottom. A white stroke segment appears near the yellow card.
15-40%
Stroke head travels around the yellow card's left edge and sweeps across the purple card; tail follows at fixed arc length - comet-like moving segment.
40-65%
Segment loops through the gaps between cards, rounding corners with radii matching the 24px card rounding.
65-90%
Stroke continues around bottom-left and sweeps up the left side; cards never move - only the stroke advances.
90-100%
Segment completes the circuit; continuous constant-speed loop.

Mechanics

trigger
autoplay loop
elements
4-card bento grid, SVG overlay path spanning the grid
properties
stroke-dashoffset (moving dash window)
timing
full circuit ~6s linear
easing
linear
loop
infinite; visible arc ~25-35% of path length

Build prompt

Build a bento grid (12-col CSS grid: tall card spanning 2 rows left, two stacked cards right, one full-width bottom; 16px gaps, 24px radius, pastel fills #FF6B4A #F9A8D4 #FBBF24 #A78BFA with dithered texture thumbnails). Overlay an absolutely-positioned SVG covering the grid with one smooth closed path weaving around and between the cards (hand-author with large arcs echoing the 24px corners). Stroke: white, 14px, round linecap, no fill. Animate a moving dash window: stroke-dasharray '0.3L 0.7L' (L = path length from getTotalLength()) and animate stroke-dashoffset 0 -> -L linearly over ~6s, infinite - a comet-like white arc endlessly orbiting the grid. Reduced motion: full static stroke at 40% opacity.
